groupCodes.CO: Contractual obligation: the provider can't bill the member for this amount.
groupCodes.PR: Patient responsibility: the member owes this amount.

carc.29: The time limit for filing the claim has expired.
carc.45: Charges exceed the contracted fee schedule; the difference is written off.
carc.50: Not covered because the payer did not consider the service medically necessary.
carc.97: Payment for this service is included in the payment for another service on the same day.
carc.197: Required precertification, authorization or notification was not obtained.

rarc.M15: Separately billed services were bundled as parts of the same procedure; separate payment is not allowed.
